title: Response Board: allow cards to be moved and dropped at negative positions
outcome: A Response Board card can be dragged or dropped above or left of the board origin (negative x/y), so the reader can make room for a new card by moving existing cards left or up instead of moving everything else right or down.
acceptance: Dragging a placed card left or up past the board origin keeps moving it to negative x/y (bounded only by the backend's existing coordinate range), and the position persists after reload.
Dropping a transcript message or a staged card left of or above the origin places it at the negative position under the pointer.
A behavioural UI test covers a drag to a negative position and a drop at a negative position; tsc is clean and the Response Board suites pass.
Greg confirms in the live UI that cards can be moved to negative positions.

completion.summary: Response Board cards can be moved and dropped at negative positions (left of and above the origin), bounded only by the backend's ±1,000,000 coordinate range. Landed in master 491dd015 (fast-forward from eb78d349) after FULL test-590a0d31 PASS and Opus2's GO; confirmed live by Greg. Independent post-landing evaluation (Codex, delegation-59910aae) passed all 4 criteria.
